summary: Answers DSH official/community capability questions from a static catalog shipped with the package, including which keel plugin covers each capability.

providers.description: Read-only index seam over catalog.json; a hosted market can replace it without changing the search/info tool names.

examples.title: Search the catalog
examples.description: Keyword search with a result limit.

examples.title: Look up one entry
examples.description: Exact lookup by entry id, keel plugin id, tool name or DSH package name.

limits.name: max_results
limits.description: Search returns at most 100 entries per call.

limits.name: catalog_bytes
limits.description: The catalog is a static package file; there is no network fetch and no live market state.
